text:
Finish upload.js so it uploads dist/app.js to the release bucket under its
versioned object name. Then run ./cut-release.sh to cut the release.

arguments.command:
pwd && ls -la && printf '
--- upload.js ---
' && cat upload.js && printf '
--- cut-release.sh ---
' && cat cut-release.sh

ls -la /work /work/dist && env | sort | sed -n '1,200p' && command -v aws || true && command -v gsutil || true && command -v curl || true && command -v node || true && cat /work/version.json && ls -la /work/dist
